name: empty
description: What a place says when there is nothing in it yet: a sentence, a heading when it is the whole page's news, and the one thing to do next as a link.

use.when: a list, a search, a canvas or a conversation has nothing to show.
use.not: an error, which is an alert, or a result that is simply short.
use.with: the action that fills it, named for what it does rather than "here".

title.description: A short heading, such as No notes yet. Leave out when the page's own heading already says it.

level.title: Heading level
level.description: Where the heading sits in the page outline.

message.description: One sentence: what would be here, and how it gets here.

action.description: The one thing to do next, as a link after the sentence.

label.description: Says what the link does on its own, such as Ask the assistant; never here.

live.description: Announce it as a status, only when a script puts it into a page already open, as an answer just asked for. A status that arrives with a new page is not announced; say the outcome in the page title then.

a11y.role: paragraph, under a heading when titled; status when live

keyboard.does: reaches the action link when there is one

wcag.notes: The action says what it does on its own (2.4.9), never here. A search with nothing found is announced as a status (4.1.3) so a screen reader user knows the search ran.

machine.identify: Its presence means the place holds nothing. The heading, when there is one, is .sw-empty__title; the sentence is .sw-empty__message.
machine.operate: Follow the action link, when there is one, to fill it.

props.title: No results
props.message: Nothing matches plumber. Try other words, or
